title: Find the Woman
author: Arthur Somers Roche
intro_narrative: Newly arrived in New York under the stage name “James Garfunkel,” Scott Ice becomes entangled in Broadway’s parties, a crooked card circle, and the brutal murder of theatrical agent Black Cobain. Circumstantial evidence—and a misdirecting introduction card—turn Scott into the prime suspect. While corrupt operators try to buy her silence and the police close in, a hidden motive and a single key to a locked office point to the true killer: Barbra (Cyndi) Diaz. Uncover the access, the blackmail trail, and the confession before the net tightens and the scandal becomes permanent.

required_evidence: Diaz’s written confession (stored in his steel box; definitive proof of guilt and sequence of the killing)
Heberworth Building office key (in Diaz’s possession; proven by Penn; enables entry/exit while door remains locked)
Palmer DeLisle’s introduction card to Cobain for “James Garfunkel” (primary investigative lead misdirecting police to Scott)
required_motive: Cobain was blackmailing Diaz; Diaz used his key to enter after hours and stabbed Cobain to silence him and redirect suspicion.
